body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Round 1: Cursor-Structure, Cursor-Correctness, Cursor-Security (OK); Cursor-Testing, Cursor-Edge-cases (NOT_SUBSTANTIVE); Codex-generic (OK).

Accepted: 3 (design-only Bash-file-ops correction, tracking-issue-read.md stale doc, get-issue-details.md doc nit). Round was non-substantial — no high-severity findings.

Rejected: BOM handling (GitHub API never returns BOM in JSON), leading-blank-line edge case (larch markers always first line), Codex security concern (theoretical only), Codex || true pattern (correct per existing convention).
